stops.name: Copperhead Hollow Garage
stops.flavor: They built engines to outrun the law long before anybody paid them to win races.

stops.name: Gulf Coast Gearworks
stops.flavor: Salt air, shrimp boats, and the best gear cutter in three states.

stops.name: Tar Heel Salvage
stops.flavor: Half the field's old wrecks end up here. So do their good parts.

stops.name: Gator Bone Salvage
stops.flavor: Swamp air eats sheet metal, but the drivetrains keep. Watch where you step.

stops.name: Piedmont Race Fabrication
stops.flavor: Ex-Cup fabricators with a wind tunnel booking every week. If you have to ask the price, the Standard rack is round the back.
